Findings triage (first grade): **HOLD — stays `finding`.**

Premise accepted as measured (card @ `49ae9f42d`, re-read this round @ `6d8231c`): `PageRegionSchema` is closed and declares `name`/`width`/`components` only, while `buildDefaultPageSchema`'s Reference Rail region carries `className`. Dormant by the card's own reachability analysis — the only persisting caller (Studio page-create seed) calls the builder with no options, so the `aside` region never enters a PUT; render-only callers honour the class and never write.

Why held rather than escalated: the only semantics-preserving fix (a region-level `className`/`responsiveStyles` carrier on `PageRegionSchema`) is an objectstack spec-lane change whose sole author today is this synthesizer — zero business pull, which under the four-lens discipline defaults to defer. The card's option analysis is complete and on-card; the day anything persists a rail page, this graduates to a `domain:spec` card in objectstack (file-at-destination) with this thread as the evidence.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

Unreachable from any persisted payload today (the only storing path calls `buildDefaultPageSchema` with no options, so the `aside` region is never written), and the real fix is a spec-shaped carrier for region-level styling — a `packages/spec` contract question that should not be opened without a producer. Seat-graded hold (not a maintainer ruling).

Restart-when: any persistence path emits the `aside` region — re-check with `grep -rn "showReferenceRail\|rightRail" packages apps` for a caller that feeds a PUT/save, and re-verify `PageRegionSchema`'s key set on the then-current spec. On discharge this becomes a spec-seat card (file at destination, objectstack `domain:spec`) for the region styling carrier, with this card as the objectui consumer half.

**Released from `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue`** by the #8773 hold audit (PM session `session_019wtfW1ZxGnP1XKGc9uZVms`, 2026-09-09T05:2xZ).

**Why it should never have been held:** no `Blocked-by:`, no `Restart-when:`, no pending ruling — nothing external was going to discharge it.

The defect is a **producer/schema contradiction inside this repo**: `buildDefaultPageSchema` emits the Reference Rail's synthesized `aside` region carrying `className`, which `PageRegionSchema` rejects — so a Reference Rail page **has no persistable spelling**. A generator whose own output the contract refuses is the same class as #5435, released in this same pass, and it is a defect rather than an observation.

⚠️ **Not re-verified against current `main`** (card dated 2026-08-11). Re-measure on pickup, and note the fix direction is a real choice — teach the schema the key, or stop the synthesizer emitting it — which turns on whether `className` on a synthesized region is meant to be authorable at all.

## ⛔ Not dispatched — the fix direction is still an open choice, and one arm is cross-lane

`domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`), R16. Opened to dispatch, read the thread, stopped. ⛔ Not claimed, ⛔ label untouched. Recording it so the next seat does not re-derive this.

Unlike two of its batch-mates (objectui#3988, objectui#3912), this card's release (comment 5596315728) is **honest about the open choice** and says so in its own words: *"the fix direction is a real choice — teach the schema the key, or stop the synthesizer emitting it — which turns on whether `className` on a synthesized region is meant to be authorable at all."* That sentence is correct, and it is also the reason the card is not ready for a dev: nobody has answered it.

The card body already prices all three arms, and the arithmetic points the same way:

- **drop the `className`** — loses `hidden xl:` and the rail's own `flex flex-col gap-4`; the rail then renders at every width and takes a column from the main content on laptop widths, which is the layout the class exists to prevent;
- **push it onto the children** — `PageComponentSchema` does declare `className`, but hiding the children leaves an empty column occupying its width below `xl`, and `gap-4` between siblings is a container concern with **no per-child spelling at all**;
- **give `PageRegionSchema` a carrier** — the only option that keeps the semantics intact, and it is an **objectstack-lane spec change**, needing the usual "is there real business pull" read.

⇒ the one arm that preserves behaviour is not in this repo, and the two arms that are in this repo both lose behaviour the class exists to produce. That is a decision, not an implementation.

⚠️ The release also carries the same sentence this seat has now falsified on three other cards from that batch (*"no `Blocked-by:`, no `Restart-when:`, no pending ruling"*) — see objectui#8773 comment 5638248875. I did **not** audit this thread's earlier comments for a `Restart-when:`, so I make no claim either way here; the batch re-check raised on objectui#8773 covers it. This card is undispatchable on its own merits regardless of what that audit finds.

⛔ Leaving `pm:queue` alone — state grading is triage's.

Ruling: batch #199 item 2 · letter D · maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-20T12:22Z

Director seat, summon #25, `session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`. Presented in detail with the recommendation **D** (a fourth option this seat added: do nothing now, close with a reopen condition; fallback C; A and B refused); the maintainer agreed 「同意」. Thread re-read to its last comment (5705835823) in the act that wrote this.

## Ruling — D: the synthesizer and the schema both stay as they are; closed, not planned, with a reopen condition

- `buildDefaultPageSchema` keeps emitting the Reference Rail's `aside` region with `className: 'hidden xl:flex flex-col gap-4'`; `PageRegionSchema` keeps declaring `name` / `width` / `components` only. Today no persistence path writes that region (Studio's `createSeed` calls the builder with no options, so `showReferenceRail` is off and the region never enters a PUT); every other caller renders in the browser, where `RegionContent` honours the class. Nothing is broken for any user; a capability (persisting a rail page) is absent, and its only author would be this synthesizer — zero pull ⇒ 「零拉动默认 defer 或 remove」.
- **A refused** (dropping the class makes the rail render at every width and take a column from the main content on laptop widths — real rendering behaviour lost to satisfy a write path nobody uses). **B refused** (hiding the children leaves an empty column below `xl`; `gap-4` is a container concern with no per-child spelling). **C not taken now** (a region-level carrier on a published `@objectstack/spec` schema is a contract widening with no producer today, and taking it back later is a breaking change).
- **Reopen condition, machine-readable for whoever finds it**: any persistence path starts emitting the `aside` region — check with `grep -rn "showReferenceRail\|rightRail" packages apps` for a caller that feeds a PUT/save. On that day the fix is **C**: file the region-level carrier (ADR-0065 `responsiveStyles` at region level, or `className`) as an objectstack `domain:spec` card, and reopen this card as the objectui consumer half with `Blocked-by:` pointing at it. The server's `unrecognized_keys` refusal naming `className` is the loud signal that the day has come.

Four-facet reading (this seat's own): ① C is the end state, D defers it until a producer exists, A/B reduce existing behaviour; ② zero users affected, zero pull; ③ the synthesizer's output being refused by the contract is a declared≠enforced shape, but the refusal sits on a write path nobody walks and is loud when walked; ④ D costs nothing, C widens a published contract, A/B lose behaviour.

`Prior rulings read: objectui#4232 (the component-level half, fixed — props into the spec's properties carrier); ADR-0089 D3a (the strict flip that surfaces this); ADR-0065 (responsiveStyles, the carrier shape C would use); the seat-graded hold 5320920097 (whose Restart-when this ruling's reopen condition restates); objectui#8773 hold-audit release 5596315728 and triage's correction 5705835823.`

Confidence gap carried: this seat did not re-take the 「no persistence path writes the region」 reading; the card's reading and triage's re-read agree, and the reopen condition covers the case where it changes.

## Execution, same stroke

Closed `not_planned`; `needs-user-decision` removed in the same stroke (closing removes the pm-state label); `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` stay as ownership.
